outline:
本課程從空調負荷計算原理與方法、濕空氣線圖討論空氣調節之過程、室內環境品質控制、風水管系統之計算與設計、空氣側系統之組成與分析、水路系統之組成與分析、直膨系統之組成與分析，逐步建構基本空調工程與設計之方法與理論。
This course provides the fundamental of Air-conditioning engineering and design. Topics include the Space and System Loads Calculations, Psychrometric Analysis of Air-conditioning Processes, Indoor Environmental Quality Control, Duct and Pipe Sizing, Hydronic Heating and Cooling System Design, and Unitary and Room Air Conditioners and Heat Pumps.
